# Orders service Requirements

This document specifies the order history export, refund and cancellation features of the Orders
service of Acme Shop v2.

## Order history export

Order history export is the feature of the Orders service that lets customers download their past
orders. Customers can export their order history as CSV. The file is generated by the Reporting
service.

## Refunds

Refunds is the feature of the Orders service that pays money back to customers. Refunds require
order cancellation to be available, because a refund request is accepted only for a cancelled order.

### Partial refunds

Partial refunds is a part of the Refunds feature: it pays back only some lines of an order and
follows the same approval steps as a full refund.

## Order cancellation

Order cancellation is the feature of the Orders service that lets customers cancel an unpaid order.
Order cancellation reuses the refund flow to release the payments it holds.
